nodes.label: Vision-Capable LLM Models Reference
nodes.rationale: Complete reference for 25+ multimodal vision models on OpenRouter (April 2026). Covers Anthropic Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, Google Gemini 2.5/3.0/3.1 + Gemma, OpenAI GPT-5.4/4o/o4-mini, Chinese models (GLM-5.1, Qwen3-VL, Kimi K2.5/2.6, MiniMax-01, MiMo V2 Omni, ByteDance Seed), xAI Grok, AllenAI Molmo. Includes cost-optimized vision routing table.
